name: fivem
description: Turns Claude Code into a FiveM developer. Stack-aware scaffolding, security + framework-purity auditing, server health checks, and ESX/QBCore → ox migration — grounded in real ox_lib, ox_core, ox_inventory and ox_target APIs rather than guessed ones. Detects whether your server runs ox, ESX, QBCore or QBox and speaks that dialect.
